svg.title: Input and selection — Truecolor / Ocean · page 1/2
svg.desc: Editable fields, forms, lists and focused choices. Actual ratatui buffer renders: mode-picker, status-picker, picker-query, picker-tabs-preview, picker-no-match, text-input-empty, text-input-typed, text-input-unfocused, text-input-invalid, text-input-disabled, text-input-secret, text-input-long, text-input-wide-text
